topic: Checkout footer visibility now applies to merchant-configurable content
caption: Shopify's latest GraphQL API update changes how checkout footer visibility works for merchant-configurable content. Previews may need updating! #ShopifyDev #CheckoutAPI #DeveloperUpdates #ShopifyPlus

document.title: Checkout footer visibility now applies to merchant-configurable content

carousel.topic: Checkout footer visibility now applies to merchant-configurable content

slides.title: Core Visibility Updates
cards: Settings now apply only to merchant-configurable content like policy links and copyright copy.
Checkouts can now display Shopify-provided transaction information regardless of visibility settings.
No fields, input types, or mutations were added, modified, or removed.

left.label: Previous Assumption
left.title: Blank Footer
items: No content rendered in footer area

right.label: New Reality
right.title: Coexisting Content
items: Shopify transaction info may still appear
Previews must account for shared space

slides.title: Updated Field Descriptions
cards: Updates also applied to CheckoutAndAccountsConfiguration objects.

slides.title: Rollout Details
events: Changes officially went live on October 15, 2026.
Applies to every GraphQL Admin API version where these branding types exist.
Primarily affects apps managing checkout branding for Shopify Plus stores.

slides.title: Update Your Previews
slides.subtitle: Developers must no longer assume that a HIDDEN visibility state results in an entirely empty footer.
